# Every auth.log event NGM (chrismfz/ngm) emits, and what ngm_auth does with it.
# Format: EVENT <interactive|token|ip|ignore>. TestNGMEventFixture pins the counted
# ones to abuseEvents; with NGM_SRC=<ngm checkout> it also fails on an event NGM
# names that this file does not list (literal authLog("X") call sites and the
# step-up stepUp/mailboxStepUp("X") -> X_FAIL). Events passed in a variable are
# not seen by the scan; RECOVERY_SET / RECOVERY_CLEAR (webmailreset.go) are
# listed by hand, and the audit helpers (apiAuditWrite, mcpAudit, php/valkey/pg
# audits, MAILSYNC tags, auditQuarantine) log authenticated actions only. Snapshot of ngm 2236cd9 2026-11-18.
